message: How do I know when to go heavier on the goblet squat?

raw.text: Your goblet squat plan is 3 sets of 8 to 12 reps, stopping with about 2 reps left in the tank. When you can do all 3 sets at 12 reps with good form and still have about 2 reps left, it's a good time to try a slightly heavier weight next session. With the heavier weight, start back near 8 reps and build up again. If anything hurts, stop and don't push through it. Keep your form smooth and you'll make steady progress.
